description_en: Applies for an invoice by billing cycle
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen apply-invoice-task --invoice-task-list vacation_normal_invoice_fee=0 international_hotel_invoice_fee=0 vas_mall_special_invoice_fee=0 remark=测试备注 flight_invoice_fee=0 international_flight_invoice_fee=0 vehicle_normal_invoice_fee=0 fu_point_invoice_fee=3.12 mail_province=浙江省 contact=张三 train_invoice_fee=0 invoice_type=1 mail_full_address=浙江省杭州市余杭区仓前街道XX路1号XX大厦101 mail_address=余杭区仓前街道XX路1号XX大厦101 email=接收电子发票的电子邮箱地址 ie_vehicle_normal_invoice_fee=0 hotel_special_invoice_fee=100 service_fee=1.02 telephone=1234567890 hotel_normal_invoice_fee=0 invoice_third_part_id=123 mail_city=杭州市 train_acceleration_package_invoice_fee=0 meal_normal_invoice_fee=0 penalty_fee=0 meal_tc7_normal_invoice_fee=0 vehicle_invoice_fee=100 --bill-date 2022-12-01 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
